in_marathi.name: Tihyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of strength and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tihyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tihyansh is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindu traditions. It is believed to be a name of the God of strength and prosperity. The name is composed of the words 'Tih' which means sun and 'Yansh' which means God. Thus, Tihyansh is the name of the deity who is believed to bring strength and prosperity to those who bear this name.
